summary: Backend testing complete for 10 new enhancement APIs (V2 & V3). All 24 test cases passed (100% success rate). Tested endpoints: Community Posts, Digital Signage, Revenue Forecast, Shift Schedule, Room Availability, Inventory Alerts, Wearable Insights, Health Coach Advice, Audit Trail, Billing Reconciliation, Predictive Alerts, Health Outcomes.

community_posts.details: Returns sample posts with proper structure (id, title, content, category, author, likes, comments_count). Pagination and category filter work correctly.

digital_signage.details: Returns content array with queue_display, announcement, health_tip, doctor_schedule types. Location filter works. No auth required (public endpoint).

revenue_forecast.details: Returns current_month (revenue, target, achievement), forecast array with predicted_revenue and confidence, revenue_by_service breakdown, trends. Requires auth.

shift_schedule.details: Returns schedule array with staff_id, staff_name, role, shifts. Includes summary with total_staff, on_duty_today, overtime_hours. Requires auth.

room_availability.details: Returns rooms array with id, name, type, capacity, amenities, available_slots. Date filter works. No auth required (public endpoint).

inventory_alerts.details: Returns alerts array with id, item, current_stock, minimum_stock, status, category. Includes summary with critical_items, low_stock_items. Requires auth.

wearable_insights.details: Returns insights array with type (positive/warning/info), title, message, icon. Includes weekly_score and trend. Requires auth.

health_coach_advice.details: Returns daily_tip, motivation, tasks array (task, completed), weekly_focus, resources. Requires auth.

audit_trail.details: Returns logs array with action, entity info, timestamp. Supports entity_type filter. Includes pagination (total, page). Requires auth.

billing_reconciliation.details: Returns summary (total_billed, total_collected, pending, overdue, collection_rate), by_payment_mode breakdown, pending_bills list, daily_collections. Requires auth.

predictive_alerts.details: Returns alerts array with patient info, alert_type, severity, prediction, confidence, recommended_action. Includes summary. Requires auth.

health_outcomes.details: Returns summary (total_patients_tracked, improved, stable, requires_attention, improvement_rate), by_condition breakdown, alerts, timeline. Requires auth.

critical_code_review_comments: All endpoints return MOCKED/sample data when DB is empty - this is by design for demo purposes
Public endpoints (community/posts, signage/content, rooms/availability) don't require auth - intentional for patient-facing features
Admin endpoints properly require JWT authentication
